## Description

Proposed robust approach to tail-risk hedging and allocation: Estimate stress or extreme-loss risk and allocate defensive assets or hedges to reduce portfolio downside exposure. This is a concept-level interpretation of the title, not a complete trading specification: the exact model inputs/target, calibration, entry/exit or rebalance rules, and position sizing are not fully defined here.
